title: Moroccan Cumin Cinnamon Roasted Almonds
summary: Crunchy roasted almonds coated with warm cumin, cinnamon and a little salt for a sweet-savoury Moroccan-style snack. They’re quick to make and ideal for grazing, packing into a lunchbox, or serving with drinks.
steps: Preheat the oven to 180°C and line a baking tray with baking paper.
In a bowl, toss the almonds with olive oil, cumin, cinnamon, salt and maple syrup until evenly coated.
Spread the almonds out in a single layer on the tray.
Roast for 10 to 12 minutes, stirring once halfway through, until fragrant and lightly browned.
Leave to cool completely on the tray so they crisp up before serving.
